name: ci-doctor
description: Everything your agents need to make CI fast, and keep it that way: a playbook, coding-agent skills and a local GitHub Actions scorer. Your agent measures CI and writes a plan you approve, then fixes failed runs, slow and flaky tests, runners and the bill, and how far an edit reaches.

interface.longDescription: Everything your agents need to make CI fast, and keep it that way: a playbook, coding-agent skills and a local GitHub Actions scorer. Your agent measures CI from its history and writes a plan for you to approve before anything changes. Day to day, its skills diagnose failed runs, cut checks an edit doesn't need, and fix slow or flaky tests without losing what they prove.
defaultPrompt: Make this repo's CI faster and cheaper: start the ci-doctor plan.
Why did this PR's CI check fail?
Our Actions bill doubled last month. Find out why.
